newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends mixed on short covering, rolling.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends mixed on short covering, rolling.

text.p: Local short covering added to continued rolling of long July positions into September to make for a mixed close in lightly traded CME lumber futures, traders said.
Lumber closed from $1.50 per thousand board feet lower to $4.10 higher with July unchanged at $374.50 per tbf and September up $2.90 at $368.80.
Liquidation continued in July but support remained on continued concern over labor problems in Canada.
Workers plan to strike three Fletcher Challenge Canada Ltd mills on July 14.
Support also came despite continued weakness in cash lumber and declining spruce prices, they said.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $359 per tbf early Friday, off $2 from midweek and $3 under last week's level.
